Anomaly details (from anomaly.json, also in your working directory):

The file data.csv in your working directory contains the daily cost data for the accounts. Investigate it with code (inspect the columns first) and determine which resource(s) caused the anomalous cost for this account on this date. A resource is identified by its name (the exact value as it appears in data.csv) and its type (the data.csv column that value comes from, written in title case with spaces instead of underscores, e.g. a value from a column named some_column has type "Some Column").

4. The root cause can be one value or many values of that column. Include every value that materially drives the change, and nothing else.
5. Answer.

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"resource": [{"name": "<resource name>", "type": "<resource type>"}]}

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
anom = '2025-10-20'

b = a[a.date.isin(base_days)]
ad = a[a.date==anom]
nb, na = len(b), len(ad)
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    gb = b.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/7  # daily avg baseline
    ga = ad.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    comp = pd.concat([gb.rename('base_daily'), ga.rename('anom')], axis=1).fillna(0)
    comp['delta'] = comp.anom - comp.base_daily
    print('===',col, 'rows base/anom:', len(b), len(ad))
    print(comp[comp.delta.abs()>0.5].sort_values('delta'))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='xykrZYR'].copy()
ad = a[a.date=='2025-10-20']; b = a[a.date.between('2025-10-13','2025-10-19')]
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    new = set(ad[col]) - set(b[col]); gone = set(b[col]) - set(ad[col])
    print(col, 'new:', new, 'gone:', gone)
print(ad[ad.instance_family=='KKbb6hcv3T'].shape)
# also check num_instances change for existing rows
key = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price']
m = ad.set_index(key).num_instances.sub(b.groupby(key).num_instances.mean(), fill_value=None) if False else None
gb = b.groupby(key).agg(base_inst=('num_instances','mean'), base_cost=('unblended_cost','sum'))
ga = ad.groupby(key).agg(anom_inst=('num_instances','sum'), anom_cost=('unblended_cost','sum'))
c = pd.concat([gb,ga],axis=1).fillna(0)
c['cost_delta'] = c.anom_cost - c.base_cost/7
print(c[c.cost_delta.abs()>5].sort_values('cost_delta').to_string())
